title: 第7章 逮蛏子
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
海岛的主岛才有理发店，可糙汉子们哪讲究这个，一个哨所都自备一个剃头推子。

    魏建业把哨所剃头那一套工具箱都给揣来了，招呼了一圈举起剪刀先看向两闺女，“剪多少？”

    婆婆当家，赵玉兰就和人打商量，“妈，要不剪成短发得了。”

    她老早就有这念头了，还能省点洗衣粉或者肥皂，她也能去掉一件麻烦事。

    而且老辈子们也都说了，长头发吸血！

    苗苗和芽芽扭着身子不愿意，那可怜劲让蔡老太忽然想起上辈子两孙女都没好结局。

    上辈子，魏建业死后，婆媳两个做了个约定。

    抚恤金全给赵玉兰，但人不能改嫁，至少得拉拔三个孩子到自食其力为止。

    头几年还行，但改革开放以后社会上新鲜事儿多。

    赵玉兰本来就跟常年在外的魏建业没什么感情基础，再加上年纪轻轻守寡难，八十年代还是领着三孩子嫁了人，还偷偷跑外地去了。

    那会蔡老太还被瘫痪的老魏头拖累着抽不开身，而且赵玉兰也没和老魏家再联系，就像断了线的风筝，从此了无音讯。

    多年后蔡老太再得到消息时，却是大孙女的死讯。

    苗苗是上班的时候骑着自行车过桥，不知怎么了跌下桥洞，脑袋刚好磕在石头上当场没了。

    芽芽命也不好，在外地叫个混混给缠上了，嫁到了深山里头，一辈子也差不多毁了。

    蔡老太回神，面色还是有几分动容，食指和拇指比划了一下，“就捡这么长，剪完后到下巴。”

    赵玉兰觉得婆婆一本正经和两孩子商量的场面挺好笑。

    小孩懂个啥啊，心智都没成熟，能做什么主。

    不过两孩子好歹是点头了，魏建业趁热打铁喊着：“来来来，爸给你们剪。”

    苗苗和芽芽冷漠脸。

    赵玉兰开始撸袖子。

    这两孩子昨天就整这死出，今儿还这样，真是不打不行！

    苗苗和芽芽嗷嗷叫的往外头跑。

    蔡老太对两孙女柔情还在，特意跟出去看看，没几分钟就领着两孩子回来了，表情一言难尽的看着大儿子，说：“她们不是故意的，只是觉得你的头型像杀人犯，心里头害怕才装高冷不理你。”

    “说什么呢！”赵玉兰想质问女儿们都是咋想的，也就顺势多看了丈夫两眼。

    魏建业留的的三七分板砖头，配合国字脸其实还挺精神，就是眉毛比较浓，都快连成一条线了，再配上黑不溜秋的皮肤和自带杀气的眼神，显得格外凶悍。

    因为今儿要干体力活，他就光溜着精壮的上半身。

    估摸也真是见过血，不笑的时候看起来确实很凶悍。
content_en:
There are barber shops only on the main island of the island, but rough guys don't pay attention to this. Every outpost has its own hair clipper.

Wei Jianye brought the toolbox for hair-shaving at the outpost, waved around, raised the scissors and looked at the two girls first, "How much should I cut?"

Since her mother-in-law was in charge, Zhao Yulan discussed with others, "Mom, how about cutting my hair short."

She had had this idea for a long time, and by saving some washing powder or soap, she could get rid of a troublesome thing.

And the elders also said that long hair sucks blood!

Miaomiao and Yaya twisted their bodies and refused, and their pitiful force suddenly reminded Mrs. Cai that neither of her two granddaughters had a happy ending in her previous life.

In the previous life, after Wei Jianye died, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law made an agreement.

The pension was all given to Zhao Yulan, but she was not allowed to remarry, and she had to raise at least three children until she could support herself.

It was okay in the first few years, but after the reform and opening up, there were a lot of new things in society.

Zhao Yulan had no relationship with Wei Jianye, who had been away all the time. In addition, it was difficult to be widowed at a young age. In the 1980s, she married her three children and secretly went out of town.

At that time, Mrs. Cai was still being dragged down by the paralyzed Old Wei, and Zhao Yulan had no further contact with the Old Wei family. She was like a kite with its string cut off, and there was no news from that day.

Many years later, when Mrs. Cai received news again, it was the death of her eldest granddaughter.

Miaomiao was riding a bicycle across the bridge when she was at work. She fell down the bridge for some reason and hit her head on a stone, killing her instantly.

Yaya's life was not good either. She got tangled up with a gangster from another place and married into a remote mountain. Her whole life was almost ruined.

Mrs. Cai came back to her senses, her face still a little moved, and she gestured with her index finger and thumb, "Just pick it up to this long, and cut it to the chin."

Zhao Yulan thought the scene of her mother-in-law discussing with her two children in a serious manner was quite funny.

What do children know? They are not mentally mature enough to make any decisions.

However, the two children nodded anyway, and Wei Jianye struck while the iron was hot and shouted: "Come on, come on, dad will cut it for you."

Miaomiao and Yaya looked indifferent.

Zhao Yulan started to roll up her sleeves.

These two kids got into trouble yesterday, and they are still like this today. They really can't do it without fighting!

Miaomiao and Yaya ran outside howling.

Mrs. Cai still had tender feelings for her two granddaughters, so she went out to have a look. Within a few minutes, she came back with her two children. She looked at her eldest son with a speechless expression and said, "They didn't do it on purpose. They just thought your head looked like a murderer. They were afraid, so they pretended to be cold and ignored you."

"What are you talking about!" Zhao Yulan wanted to ask her daughters what they were thinking, so she looked at her husband a few more times.

Wei Jianye's 37-point bricks, combined with the Chinese character face, are actually quite energetic, but his eyebrows are thicker, almost forming a line. Coupled with his dark skin and murderous eyes, he looks particularly fierce.

Because he had to do physical work today, he kept his muscular upper body naked.

He must have seen blood, and he looks really fierce when he's not smiling.
